title: Vali's funeral ritual
introduction: Rama hurries up Sugreeva to proceed with the funeral ceremony of Vali instead of sitting around the body and wailing endlessly. Rama tersely tells about living being's dependency on the eternal Time, Fate and the Absolute. Then Sugreeva takes charge of the situation and arranges for the monarchical funeral to Vali. At the final departure of her husband, Tara again laments. Ultimately Vali's body is committed to fire for his voyage to heavens on a remote avenue.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे पंच विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 25th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
स सुग्रीवम् च ताराम् च स अंगदाम् सह लक्ष्मणः |
समान शोकः काकुत्स्थः सांत्वयन् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa sugrīvam ca tārām ca sa aṃgadām saha lakśmaṇaḥ |
samāna śokaḥ kākutsthaḥ sāṃtvayan idam abravīt
verses.translation: While a similar disquiet of Sugreeva is prevailing over Rama and Lakshmana, Rama palliatively said this to Sugreeva, and even to Tara together with Angada.

glosses.meaning: together with, Angada, to Tara, also

verses.devanagari:
न शोक परितापेन श्रेयसा युज्यते मृतः |
यद् अत्र अनंतरम् कार्यम् तत् समाधातुम् अर्हथ
verses.iast:
na śoka paritāpena śreyasā yujyate mṛtaḥ |
yad atra anaṃtaram kāryam tat samādhātum arhatha
verses.translation: "Deceased will not derive bliss by sorrowful mourning, hence it will be appropriate to arrange for that work which is subsequent in this matter.

glosses.meaning: deceased one, with bliss, not, be coupled - will not derive
which, subsequent, work to be done

verses.devanagari:
लोक वृत्तम् अनुष्ठेयम् कृतम् वो बाष्प मोक्षणम् |
न कालाद् उत्तरम् किंचित् कर्म शक्यम् उपासितुम्
verses.iast:
loka vṛttam anuṣṭheyam kṛtam vo bāṣpa mokṣaṇam |
na kālād uttaram kiñcit karma śakyam upāsitum
verses.translation: "Worldly observances are to be observed, thus your activity of tear-shedding this far is justifiable, but after the lapse of time of any individual, it is impossible to activate that individual by any other remote activity like weeping.
notes: A person comes to life after ten months incarceration in mother's womb; lives for a hundred year period, but on death, dead body is to be removed within ten hours. If a dead body is kept unattended for more than ten hours of death, a blemish called paryuṣita doṣa occurs. Thus, it is said, 'The duties ordained according to their time value are to be attended on time, otherwise if you lapse that particular time by shedding tears alone, there is no merit to the departed soul...' Maheshvara Tiirtha

glosses.meaning: worldly, observance, is to be observed
any, work - by any remote activity

verses.devanagari:
नियतिः कारणम् लोके नियतिः कर्म साधनम् |
नियतिः सर्व भूतानाम् नियोगेषु इह कारणम्
verses.iast:
niyatiḥ kāraṇam loke niyatiḥ karma sādhanam |
niyatiḥ sarva bhūtānām niyogeṣu iha kāraṇam
verses.translation: "Fate is the cause of all the worlds, Fate is the instrument for action, Fate is the deciding factor for motivation of all beings in these worlds.
notes: Here the word niyati has three deflections, svabhāva vāda Nature-theory, niyati vāda Fate-theory, kāla vāda Time-theory, and all these culminate into Theism, for theologises. Atheists hold the above three in each of its own. svabhāva: kāraṇam vinā eva sarvam bhavati iti svabhāva vāda... 'without any apparent reason everything happens on its own, where the question of merit or sin does not arise...' and the adherents of karmic-cycle say, niyati: pūrva janma ārjita dharma adharmau niyati, sa eva sarvasya kāraṇam... 'the merit or sin earned or accrued in last births brings forth the fruits of the present and future births...' kāla Time, the undisputable time factor is the reason for everything, also called 'god'.

If the attribute of god to the Time is removed and seen only as time with its watches, Rama is said to have spoken in the perfect tongue of perfect atheists in these four or five verses given below. However, if there is an All-Supervisory-God, these three will culminate in Him and then He becomes the Time, the presiding authority of worlds. For this the śveta aśvatara upaniśad: has this hymn at its 1-2: kālaḥ svabhāvo niyatiḥ yadṛcā bhūtāni yoniḥ puruṣa iti cintyā |'time, nature, fate, chance, material, power, intellect... thus all these are [thought to be the cause, but in vain...] Thus the words used as 'Fate' 'Time' are alterable with 'Supreme Being/Person.'

glosses.meaning: SOP standard operating procedure of universe, Fate, God, Time

verses.devanagari:
न कर्ता कस्यचित् कश्चित् नियोगे च अपि न ईश्वरः |
स्वभावे वर्तते लोकः तस्य कालः परायणम्
verses.iast:
na kartā kasyacit kaścit niyoge ca api na īśvaraḥ |
svabhāve vartate lokaḥ tasya kālaḥ parāyaṇam
verses.translation: "None is an instrument in motivating someone else to do something or otherwise, none is also a controlling entity of others, and even the world functions in its own nature, and that Time is cardinal for that world.
notes: Unlike Bhagavad Gita, which says everything in first person, here Rama is saying that he alone is Supreme, but naming Time, Fate etc., instead of using first person and declaring about himself.

glosses.meaning: lord [not a controlling entity of others,] even, also, he is not
world, in its own, nature, functions

verses.devanagari:
न कालः कालम् अत्येति न कालः परिहीयते |
स्वभावम् च समासाद्य न कश्चित् अतिवर्तते
verses.iast:
na kālaḥ kālam atyeti na kālaḥ parihīyate |
svabhāvam ca samāsādya na kaścit ativartate
verses.translation: "Time will not transcend Time, neither Time transgresses itself, and on attaining the nature endowed by Time nothing can overstep its own Fate.

glosses.meaning: Time, over Time, will not, transcend

verses.devanagari:
न कालस्य अस्ति बंधुत्वम् न हेतुर् न पराक्रमः |
न मित्र ज्ञाति संबन्धः कारणम् न आत्मनो वशः
verses.iast:
na kālasya asti baṃdhutvam na hetur na parākramaḥ |
na mitra jñāti sambandhaḥ kāraṇam na ātmano vaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Time has no kinship, thus it has no partiality, there is nothing instrumental to override Time, hence nothing can override it, and there are no causative factors to Time that connect through friends or relatives, hence all are equal in its viewpoint.

glosses.meaning: to Time, kinship, not, is there
friends, relations, sambandhaH na kaaraNam = = such connectivity, is not, the causative factor.

verses.devanagari:
किम् तु काल परीणामो द्रष्टव्यः साधु पश्यता |
धर्मः च अर्थः च कामः च कालक्रम समाहिताः
verses.iast:
kim tu kāla parīṇāmo draṣṭavyaḥ sādhu paśyatā |
dharmaḥ ca arthaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca kālakrama samāhitāḥ
verses.translation: "But even the mutations brought forth by Time are observable by a perceiver with a clear vision, and the virtue, wealth, pleasures are to be perceived as cumulated during the course of Time.
notes: If it is asked that, 'If Time takes care of everything what is it humans have to do, except to live like other animals?' For this the above verse says that 'a gentle perceiver has to perceive the changes brought in by the course of Time and according to them and also taking the help of scriptural dictates, one has to intelligently undergo the course of events, without asserting himself of his own achievements or without blaming himself or that imposing Time, should the results be distasteful. This is the way to attain the humanly-means, puruṣa artha -s. And this is the way to live different from animals.

glosses.meaning: while clearly, on who is perceiving

glosses.itrans: dharmaH ca arthaH ca kaamaH ca
glosses.iast: dharmaḥ ca arthaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: धर्मः च अर्थः च कामः च
glosses.meaning: virtue, also, wealth, also, pleasures, also

verses.devanagari:
इतः स्वाम् प्रकृतिम् वाली गतः प्राप्तः क्रिया फलम् |
साम दान अर्थ संयोगैः पवित्रम् प्लवग ईश्वर
verses.iast:
itaḥ svām prakṛtim vālī gataḥ prāptaḥ kriyā phalam |
sāma dāna artha saṃyogaiḥ pavitram plavaga īśvara
verses.translation: "That king of fly-jumpers Vali departed from here on attaining his own nature of subtle-soul, and he obtained pious fruits connected with his one time actions befitting to a king like, friendliness, courteousness, and forgivingness required of a king.

glosses.meaning: his own, nature [of subtle-soul, on attaining, departed
pious, exploits, fruits [of actions befitting to a king,] obtained.

verses.devanagari:
स्व धर्मस्य च संयोगात् जितः तेन महात्मना |
स्वर्गः परिगृहीतः च प्राणान् अपरिरक्षता
verses.iast:
sva dharmasya ca saṃyogāt jitaḥ tena mahātmanā |
svargaḥ parigṛhītaḥ ca prāṇān aparirakṣatā
verses.translation: "That great-souled Vali did not care to safeguard his own lives in combat, and by virtue of his own rightness of a true combatant unworried of his life, he acquired heaven.
notes: This is to say Vali has attained a higher heaven than the routine heaven ruled by Indra, where the merit and demerit are metered. These higher heavens are impossible abodes for usual seekers of release from karmic cycle, but they chance upon certain blessed souls like Vali, who is sent from here tovaikunṭha Vishnu's Milky-Oceanic abode, by no less than Rama himself.

glosses.meaning: without, completely, guarding - uncaring for himself
his own, rightness, by association of - by virtue of

verses.devanagari:
एषा वै नियतिः श्रेष्ठा याम् गतो हरि यूथपः |
तत् अलम् परितापेन प्राप्त कालम् उपास्यताम्
verses.iast:
eṣā vai niyatiḥ śreṣṭhā yām gato hari yūthapaḥ |
tat alam paritāpena prāpta kālam upāsyatām
verses.translation: "Which course the commander of monkeys undertook is the choicest course of fatality, and hence, enough is this sorrowing, and let works incumbent on the present time be undertaken reverently..." So said Rama to Sugreeva.
notes: This is choicest course Vali sought after is to die in the course of fighting. For this it is said in Dharmaakuutam: atra niyati śabdāpara paryāyam janmāntara kṛta karma kālam apekṣya phalati | kalo api pūrva kṛta karma sāpekṣya eva | na svatantra | evam kāla karma parādhīnaḥ puruṣo api na karmaṇi svatantraḥ |'by the word niyati the results of earlier births come to fruition abiding the Time... Time is bound by the results of earlier births... as such no independency to Time... thus, bound by the Time cycle, an individual is also not independent...'

glosses.meaning: this, course of fatality, is the choicest
chanced, time[works incumbent on present time]

verses.devanagari:
वचन अन्ते तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः पर वीर हा |
अवदत् प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् सुग्रीवम् गत चेतसम्
verses.iast:
vacana ante tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīra hā |
avadat praśritam vākyam sugrīvam gata cetasam
verses.translation: At the close of Rama's sentence Lakshmana, the eliminator of braving foes, spoke this courteous sentence to the disconcerted Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: of Rama, sentence, at close of, but

verses.devanagari:
कुरु त्वम् अस्य सुग्रीव प्रेत कार्यम् अनंतरम् |
तारा अंगदाभ्याम् सहितो वालिनो दहनम् प्रति
verses.iast:
kuru tvam asya sugrīva preta kāryam anaṃtaram |
tārā aṃgadābhyām sahito vālino dahanam prati
verses.translation: "Sugreeva, you attend to the funeral rites, to be performed subsequently along with those two, Tara and Angada, and arrange for the cremation of Vali.

verses.devanagari:
समाज्ञापय काष्ठानि शुष्काणि च बहूनि च |
चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि वालि संस्कार कारणात्
verses.iast:
samājñāpaya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇi ca bahūni ca |
candanāni ca divyāni vāli saṃskāra kāraṇāt
verses.translation: "Order at once for substantial dry firewood, likewise for finest sandalwood, for the purpose of the exequies of Vali.

verses.devanagari:
समाश्वासय दीनम् त्वम् अंगदम् दीन चेतसम् |
मा भूः बालिश बुद्धिः त्वम् त्वत् अधीनम् इदम् पुरम्
verses.iast:
samāśvāsaya dīnam tvam aṃgadam dīna cetasam |
mā bhūḥ bāliśa buddhiḥ tvam tvat adhīnam idam puram
verses.translation: "Bolster up that miserable Angada who is heartbroken, you too should not become frivolous in thinking as this city Kishkindha is now dependant on you.

verses.devanagari:
अंगदः तु आनयेत् माल्यम् वस्त्राणि विविधानि च |
घृतम् तैलम् अथो गन्धान् यत् च अत्र समनंतरम्
verses.iast:
aṃgadaḥ tu ānayet mālyam vastrāṇi vividhāni ca |
ghṛtam tailam atho gandhān yat ca atra samanaṃtaram
verses.translation: "Let Angada bring wreaths, different cloths, ghee, oils, as well perfumes and other items that are consequently useful in funeral.

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् तार शिबिकाम् शीघ्रम् आदाय आगच्छ संभ्रमात् |
त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता हि अस्मिन् काले विशेषतः
verses.iast:
tvam tāra śibikām śīghram ādāya āgaccha sambhramāt |
tvarā guṇavatī yuk{}tā hi asmin kāle viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: "And Lt. Tara, you go quickly and come readily fetching a palanquin of the dead, for despatch is a merit, which is truly worthwhile, especially at these times.

glosses.meaning: palanquin, [covered litter of the dead, sedan chair]
on taking, quickly, you come back
despatch [2 performing business, a task, etc., promptly

verses.devanagari:
सज्जी भवन्तु प्लवगाः शिबिक वाहन उचिताः |
समर्था बलिनः चैव निर्हरिष्यन्ति वालिनम्
verses.iast:
sajjī bhavantu plavagāḥ śibika vāhana ucitāḥ |
samarthā balinaḥ caiva nir.hhariṣyanti vālinam
verses.translation: "Let suitable, proficient and sturdy Vaanara-s be at the ready as the bearers of the litter of the dead to carry away Vali." Thus said Lakshmana to Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: litter of the dead, bearers, suitable ones
out, carry off - to cart him away.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवम् सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनः |
तस्थौ भ्रातृ समीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः पर वीरहा
verses.iast:
evam uk{}tvā tu sugrīvam sumitra ānanda vardhanaḥ |
tasthau bhrātṛ samīpastho lakṣmaṇaḥ para vīrahā
verses.translation: Speaking thus to Sugreeva that enhancer of his mother Sumitra's delight and the eliminator of braving foes, Lakshmana stepped off and stayed behind his brother Rama.

glosses.meaning: at brother's, nearby staying, stepped back- withdrawn.

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तारः संभ्रान्त मानसः |
प्रविवेश गुहाम् शीघ्रम् शिबिका आसक्त मानसः
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tāraḥ sambhrānta mānasaḥ |
praviveśa guhām śīghram śibikā āsak{}ta mānasaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Lakshmana Lt. Tara's mood became hectic and he fleetly entered Kishkindha with his mood firmed up to get the litter of the dead.

glosses.meaning: litter of the dead, firmed up, in mood
fleetly, into cave - into Kishkindha, entered.

verses.devanagari:
आदाय शिबिकाम् तारः स तु पर्यापयत् पुनः |
वानरैः उह्यमानाम् ताम् शूरैः उद्वहन उचितैः
verses.iast:
ādāya śibikām tāraḥ sa tu paryāpayat punaḥ |
vānaraiḥ uhyamānām tām śūraiḥ udvahana ucitaiḥ
verses.translation: Lt. Tara came back in a trice fetching that litter of the dead, getting it carried by gritty and suitable Vanara-s.

glosses.meaning: return, came, falling - rebound that quickly] = came back in a trice.

verses.devanagari:
दिव्याम् भद्र आसन युताम् शिबिकाम् स्यंदन उपमम् |
पक्षि कर्मभिः आचित्राम् द्रुम कर्म विभूषिताम्
अचिताम् चित्र पत्तीभिः सुनिविष्टाम् समंततः |
विमानम् इव सिद्धानाम् जाल वात आयान आयुताम्
सुनियुक्तानाम् विशालाम् च सुकृताम् शिल्पिभिः कृतात् |
दारु पर्वतकोपेताम् चारु कर्म परिष्कृताम्
वर आभरण हारैः च चित्र माल्य उपशोभिताम् |
गुहागहन संच्छन्नाम् रक्त चन्दन भूषिताम्
पुष्प ओघैः समभिच्छन्नाम् पद्म मालाभिः एव च |
तरुण आदित्य वर्णाभिः भ्राजमानभिः आवृताम्
verses.iast:
divyām bhadra āsana yutām śibikām syaṃdana upamam |
pakśi karmabhiḥ ācitrām druma karma vibhūṣitām
acitām citra pattībhiḥ suniviṣṭām samaṃtataḥ |
vimānam iva siddhānām jāla vāta āyāna āyutām
suniyuk{}tānām viśālām ca sukṛtām śilpibhiḥ kṛtāt |
dāru parvatakopetām cāru karma pariṣkṛtām
vara ābharaṇa hāraiḥ ca citra mālya upaśobhitām |
guhāgahana sañcchannām rak{}ta candana bhūṣitām
puṣpa oghaiḥ samabhicchannām padma mālābhiḥ eva ca |
taruṇa āditya varṇābhiḥ bhrājamānabhiḥ āvṛtām
verses.translation: That palanquin is having a majestic throne and in similarity it is like a divine chariot which is adorned and beautified with figurines of birds and trees in high relief. From all over it is well set in with strikingly carved figures of foot soldiers, and it is like an aircraft of the gifted souls, namely siddha-s, with grills and ventilators. Well seamed-in are its parts and also spacious it is, and well crafted by the crafty craftsmen it has wooden play-hills carved in its walls, and finishing touches with a fine artistry of polishing are given to that palanquin. It is elaborated with best ornaments and strings of pearls, gems, beads and the like, and even with amazing flowery-tassels. Its cabin's roof is covered with an ornamental woodcraft of red-sandalwood. It is well covered over with lots of flowers, and in its shade it is like a tender sun, while garlands of red-lotuses are further brightening it. And Lt. Tara brought such a litter of the dead.
notes: These few verses describing the royal palanquin are not available in critical edition and even in some ancient mms. The word guhā gahana is not 'deep cave' as in ordinary sense. It is one among the rare expressions used in Ramayana. guhā gahana śabdena śibika upari prasārya māṇānām pañjaram ucyate... 'the roof of the cabin / cage of the palanquin...' is the meaning of the above words. Tilaka. [After Dr. Satya Vrat.].

glosses.meaning: striking [figures,] of foot soldiers, carved with
all, over su ni viSTaam = well, in, set
grills, air, to enter [with small ventilators,] which has. su niyuktaanaam = we, seamed in [its parts]
with fine, artistry [of polishing,] finishing touches given
such a palanquin, [Tara brought on his coming.]

verses.devanagari:
ईदृशी शिबिकाम् दृष्ट्वा रमो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् |
क्षिप्रम् विनीयताम् वली प्रेत कार्यम् विधीयताम्
verses.iast:
īdṛśī śibikām dṛṣṭvā ramo lakśmaṇam abravīt |
kśipram vinīyatām valī preta kāryam vidhīyatām
verses.translation: On seeing such a sort of palanquin Rama said to Lakshmana, "Let Vali be taken away quickly and funeral ceremony be undertaken."

glosses.meaning: such sort of, palanquin, on seeing

verses.devanagari:
ततो वालिनम् उद्यम्य सुग्रीवः शिबिकाम् तदा |
आरोपयत विक्रोशन् अंगदेन सह एव तु
verses.iast:
tato vālinam udyamya sugrīvaḥ śibikām tadā |
āropayata vikrośan aṃgadena saha eva tu
verses.translation: Thereafter Sugreeva along with Angada and others lifted up and then lodged Vali in the litter of the dead squalling woefully.

glosses.meaning: into litter, set him in - lodged.

verses.devanagari:
आरोप्य शिबिकाम् चैव वालिनम् गत जीवितम् |
अलंकारैः च विविधैः माल्यैः वस्त्रैः च भूषितम्
आज्ञापयत् तदा राजा सुग्रीवः प्लवग ईश्वरः |
और्ध्व देहिकम् आर्यस्य क्रियताम् अनुरूपतः
verses.iast:
āropya śibikām caiva vālinam gata jīvitam |
alaṃkāraiḥ ca vividhaiḥ mālyaiḥ vastraiḥ ca bhūṣitam
ājñāpayat tadā rājā sugrīvaḥ plavaga īśvaraḥ |
aur.hdhva dehikam āryasya kriyatām anurūpataḥ
verses.translation: Thus setting that deceased Vali who is diversely decorated and adorned with garlands and cloths onto the palanquin, then Sugreeva, the king of best fly-jumpers, has ordered, "let the funeral ceremony of this noble brother of mine be undertaken, befitting to his magnificence...

glosses.meaning: garlands, cloths, also, one who is adorned with, Vali
of the noble [brother of mine, Vali's]

verses.devanagari:
विश्राणयन्तो रत्नानि विविधानि बहूनि च |
अग्रतः प्लवगा यान्तु शिबिका तद् अनंतरम्
verses.iast:
viśrāṇayanto ratnāni vividhāni bahūni ca |
agrataḥ plavagā yāntu śibikā tad anaṃtaram
verses.translation: "Let the vanara-s proceed in van strewing various gems plentifully, and the palanquin afterward...

verses.devanagari:
राज्ञाम् ऋद्धि विशेषा हि दृश्यन्ते भुवि यादृशाः |
तादृशैः इह कुर्वन्तु वानरा भ्रतृउ सत् क्रियाम्
verses.iast:
rājñām ṛddhi viśeṣā hi dṛśyante bhuvi yādṛśāḥ |
tādṛśaiḥ iha kurvantu vānarā bhratṛu sat kriyām
verses.translation: "In which way the grandiose of monarchical opulence will be conspicuous on earth when kings decease, in a similar way the Vanara-s have to immortalise lord Vali now," Sugreeva ordered monkeys in that way.

verses.devanagari:
तादृशम् वालिनः क्षिप्रम् प्राकुर्वन् और्ध्वदैहिकम् |
अंगदम् परिरभ्य आशु तार प्रभृतयः तथा
क्रोशन्तः प्रययुः सर्वे वानरा हत बान्धवाः |
verses.iast:
tādṛśam vālinaḥ kśipram prākurvan aur.hdhvadaihikam |
aṃgadam parirabhya āśu tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tathā
krośantaḥ prayayuḥ sarve vānarā hata bāndhavāḥ |
verses.translation: On performing services to the dead in the same way as ordered by Sugreeva, then all of those vanara-s like Lt. Tara and others, have promptly started out hemming round Angada, keening over their dead relative Vali.

glosses.meaning: funeral, rites - service to the dead
is dead, those whose relative is

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रणिहिताः सर्वा वानर्यो अस्य वशानुगाः
चुक्रुशुः वीर वीर इति भूयः क्रोशन्ती ताः प्रियम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ praṇihitāḥ sarvā vānaryo asya vaśānugāḥ
cukruśuḥ vīra vīra iti bhūyaḥ krośantī tāḥ priyam |
verses.translation: Then all the female adherents of Vali came together and wept saying, 'oh, brave one, oh, brave one...' and they repeatedly wept thus for their departed dear.

glosses.meaning: his [Vali's,] under control, in tow, going - adherents
oh, brave one, oh, brave one, thus as
they, for their beloved, repeatedly, wept.

verses.devanagari:
तारा प्रभृतयः सर्वा वानर्यो हत बान्धव
अनुजग्मुः च भर्तारम् क्रोशंत्यः करुण स्वनाः |
verses.iast:
tārā prabhṛtayaḥ sarvā vānaryo hata bāndhava
anujagmuḥ ca bhartāram krośaṃtyaḥ karuṇa svanāḥ |
verses.translation: Lady Tara and all other female Vanara-s, whose husband is dead, followed the funeral procession wailing in a pathetic tone.

glosses.meaning: those that have a killed, relative - husband

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् रुदित शब्देन वानरीणाम् वन अंतरे
वनानि गिरयः चैव विक्रोशंति इव सर्वतः |
verses.iast:
tāsām rudita śabdena vānarīṇām vana aṃtare
vanāni girayaḥ caiva vikrośaṃti iva sarvataḥ |
verses.translation: With the din of wailing of those Vanara females in the interiors of the forest, that forest along with its hillocks appeared to be wailing noisily.

glosses.meaning: their, of female vanara-s, wailing, by the din of
is much - noisily wailing, as though [it appeared.]

verses.devanagari:
पुलिने गिरि नद्याः तु विविक्ते जल संवृते
चिताम् चक्रुः सुबहवो वानरा वन चारिणः |
verses.iast:
puline giri nadyāḥ tu vivik{}te jala saṃvṛte
citām cakruḥ subahavo vānarā vana cāriṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Many Vanara-s have arranged a funeral pile on an unpopulated sandy isle, around which brooks from the cascades of hills are encircling.

verses.devanagari:
अवरोप्य ततः स्कंधात् शिबिकाम् वानरोत्तमाः
तस्थुः एकांतम् आश्रित्य सर्वे शोक परायणाः |
verses.iast:
avaropya tataḥ skaṃdhāt śibikām vānarottamāḥ
tasthuḥ ekāṃtam āśritya sarve śoka parāyaṇāḥ |
verses.translation: All of those best vanara-s then lifted down that palanquin from their shoulders and stood aside weltered in melancholy.

glosses.meaning: from shoulders, palanquin, on lifting down

verses.devanagari:
ततः तारा पतिम् दृष्ट्वा शिबिका तल शायिनम्
आरोप्य अंके शिरः तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता |
verses.iast:
tataḥ tārā patim dṛṣṭvā śibikā tala śāyinam
āropya aṃke śiraḥ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā |
verses.translation: Lady Tara on seeing at her husband Vali recumbent on the bier of the litter of the dead, she then brought his head onto her lap, and wailed painfully.

glosses.meaning: his, head, in lap, on bringing up

verses.devanagari:
हा वानर महाराज हा नाथ माम् वत्सल
हा महार्हः महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम् |
जनम् न पश्यसि इमम् त्वम् कस्मात् शोक अभिपीडितम्
verses.iast:
hā vānara mahārāja hā nātha mām vatsala
hā mahārhaḥ mahābāho hā mama priya paśya mām |
janam na paśyasi imam tvam kasmāt śoka abhipīḍitam
verses.translation: "O, great king of monkeys... o, my consort... my dear... o, meritorious one, o, mighty one, o, my dear... see me... why do not you see this grief-stricken creature, that is me...

verses.devanagari:
प्रहृष्टम् इह ते वक्त्रम् गत असोः अपि मानद |
अस्त अर्क सम वर्णम् च दृश्यते जीवतो यथा
verses.iast:
prahṛṣṭam iha te vak{}tram gata asoḥ api mānada |
asta arka sama varṇam ca dṛśyate jīvato yathā
verses.translation: "Though your lives have gone your face is appearing to be highly enchanting as if it has a similar dazzle of the sun on dusking mountain, as it had when you were alive.

glosses.meaning: at dusking mountain, sun, similar, shade [dazzle of sun]
[face of] one who is living, as with

verses.devanagari:
एष त्वाम् राम रूपेण कालः कर्षति वानर |
येन स्म विधवाः सर्वाः कृता एक इषुणा रणे
verses.iast:
eṣa tvām rāma rūpeṇa kālaḥ karṣati vānara |
yena sma vidhavāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtā eka iṣuṇā raṇe
verses.translation: "Time-god in the mien of this Rama is hauling you away, oh, vanara, on rendering all of us as widows by flinging a single arrow in the fight.

glosses.meaning: all are, as widows, rendered, we are.

verses.devanagari:
इमाः ताः तव राजेन्द्र वानर्यो अप्लवगाः तव|
पादैः विकृष्टम् अध्वानम् आगताः किम् न बुध्यसे
तव इष्टा ननु चैव इमा भार्याः चन्द्र निभ आननाः |
verses.iast:
imāḥ tāḥ tava rājendra vānaryo aplavagāḥ tava |
pādaiḥ vikṛṣṭam adhvānam āgatāḥ kim na budhyase
tava iṣṭā nanu caiva imā bhāryāḥ candra nibha ānanāḥ |
verses.translation: "These are those female vanara-s of yours, oh, best king, unable to come by leaping and jumping as they are wont to, they have come treading a much lengthy way of yours, why do not you mind them? They with their faces like moonshine are your cherished wives, isn't it!

glosses.meaning: to you, dearest ones, isn't it.

verses.devanagari:
इदानीम् न ईक्षसे कस्मात् सुग्रीवम् प्लवग ईश्वरम्
एते हि सचिवा राजन् तार प्रभृतयः तव |
पुर वासि जनः च अयम् परिवार्य विषीदति
verses.iast:
idānīm na īkṣase kasmāt sugrīvam plavaga īśvaram
ete hi sacivā rājan tāra prabhṛtayaḥ tava |
pura vāsi janaḥ ca ayam parivārya viṣīdati
verses.translation: "What for you are not seeing the lord of fly-jumpers Sugreeva, and these Lt. Tara and others are all your ministers, oh, king, and even the people dwelling in Kishkindha city have gathered around you and sinking down, why do not you mind them?

glosses.meaning: what for, not, you are seeing
gathering round, very much, sinking down

verses.devanagari:
विसर्जय एनान् सचिवान् यथा उचितम् अरिन्दम |
ततः क्रीडामहे सर्वा वनेषु मदनोत्कटाः
verses.iast:
visarjaya enān sacivān yathā ucitam arindama |
tataḥ krīḍāmahe sarvā vaneṣu madanotkaṭāḥ
verses.translation: "Bid adieu to these ministers as usual, oh, enemy subjugator, then we all can sportfully wander in the woods in voluptuousness." Thus Tara mourned for Vali.

glosses.meaning: as earlier - where puram is a rare word]

verses.devanagari:
एवम् विलपतीम् ताराम् पति शोक परीवृताम् |
उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यः शोक कर्शिताः
verses.iast:
evam vilapatīm tārām pati śoka parīvṛtām |
utthāpayanti sma tadā vānaryaḥ śoka karśitāḥ
verses.translation: While Tara is enwrapped in the grief for her husband and wailing that way, then other female Vanara-s, who are equally haggard by grief have lifted her up and took her away from the body of Vali.

glosses.meaning: started to lift up, they have [taken her away.]

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवेण ततः सार्धम् अंगदः पितरम् रुदन् |
चिताम् आरोपयामास शोकेन अभिप्लुत इन्द्रियः
verses.iast:
sugrīveṇa tataḥ sārdham aṃgadaḥ pitaram rudan |
citām āropayāmāsa śokena abhipluta indriyaḥ
verses.translation: Angada wailing along with Sugreeva, started to mount his father's body onto pyre in an involuntary way, as his senses are deluged under grief.

glosses.meaning: father, onto pyre, started to mount.

verses.devanagari:
ततो अग्निम् विधिवत् दत्त्वा सो अपसव्यम् चकार ह |
पितरम् दीर्घम् अध्वानम् प्रस्थितम् व्याकुल इन्द्रियः
verses.iast:
tato agnim vidhivat dattvā so apasavyam cakāra ha |
pitaram dīrgham adhvānam prasthitam vyākula indriyaḥ
verses.translation: On giving fire to the pyre procedurally, then Angada with dismayed senses performed circumambulations in an anticlockwise direction to his father, who is voyaging on a remote avenue.
notes: The word apa savya means another way, 'to keep the sacred thread on the right shoulder...' which will be observed only in funeral ceremonies. Usually this sacred thread of Hindus is sling on the left shoulder, which is called savyam. In funeral rites it is occasionally changed onto right shoulder. In temples when circumambulations are performed, the devotee faces the idol, keeping his right to left of the idol and moves on his left, around sanctum sanctorum. This is called savya pradakśiṇa and in funerals it is other way round, called apa savya pradakśiṇa.

glosses.meaning: anti, circumambulations, [moving around in anticlockwise direction]

verses.devanagari:
संस्कृत्य वालिनम् तम् तु विधिवत् प्लवगर्षभाः |
आजग्मुः उदकम् कर्तुम् नदीम् शुभ जलाम् शिवाम्
verses.iast:
saṃskṛtya vālinam tam tu vidhivat plavagarṣabhāḥ |
ājagmuḥ udakam kartum nadīm śubha jalām śivām
verses.translation: On cremating Vali procedurally those best fly-jumpers arrived at the propitious river with auspicious waters to offer water oblations to the departed soul.

glosses.meaning: water, to make - to offer water oblations

verses.devanagari:
ततः ते सहिताः तत्र हि सः अंगदम् स्थाप्य च अग्रतः |
सुग्रीव तारा सहिताः सिषिचुः वानरा जलम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ te sahitāḥ tatra hi saḥ aṃgadam sthāpya ca agrataḥ |
sugrīva tārā sahitāḥ siṣicuḥ vānarā jalam
verses.translation: Those vanara-s on coming together along with Sugreeva and Lady Tara, and then locating Angada in their front, they have offered water oblations to the soul of Vali.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवेण एव दीनेन दीनो भूत्वा महाबलः |
समान शोकः काकुत्स्थः प्रेत कार्याणि अकारयत्
verses.iast:
sugrīveṇa eva dīnena dīno bhūtvā mahābalaḥ |
samāna śokaḥ kākutsthaḥ preta kāryāṇi akārayat
verses.translation: He whose sadness evened up with that of Sugreeva, and who became one with Sugreeva in haplessness, that great mighty Rama effectuated the funeral rites of Vali.

glosses.meaning: with hapless one, with Sugreeva, thus
even up, in sadness - on becoming

verses.devanagari:
ततो अथ तम् वालिनम् अग्र्य पौरुषम्
प्रकाशम् इक्ष्वाकु वर इषुणा हतम् |
प्रदीप्य दीप्त अग्नि सम ओजसम् तदा
स लक्ष्मणम् रामम् उपेयवान् हरिः
verses.iast:
tato atha tam vālinam agrya pauruṣam
prakāśam ikśvāku vara iṣuṇā hatam |
pradīpya dīpta agni sama ojasam tadā
sa lakśmaṇam rāmam upeyavān hariḥ
verses.translation: On cremating Vali of lofty aplomb and manifest-renown and whom the arrow of that Rama, the best of Ikshvaku dynasty has eliminated, Sugreeva then approached that Rama, who is with Lakshmana at his side, and whose flair equals a flaming fire.
notes: In fact Sugreeva is fully wet with river waters and effusing is water from his clothing and body, yet he is compared with flaming blaze, only to say that Sugreeva has washed off the sin called Vali and bathed in the pious waters called Rama's mercy, thus his resplendence is pure and fire-like. Govindaraja. By these observances of funeral rites, water oblations etc., the Vanara- may not be regarded as monkeys or as other mammals, but this race is to be regarded a divine race adherent to Vedic practises. They took birth at the hest of Brahma.

glosses.meaning: Ikshvaku-s, best one from, by arrow, eliminated
